result:
Summary: The ManuRAG framework explores four variations for aligning textual and visual data in manufacturing QA, investigating whether alignment should occur before embedding, within the embedding space, or after embedding. ManuRAG1 maintains separate text and image vector databases, using both for retrieval and combining results in a multi-modal language model. Text chunks are embedded using Ada v2, while images are processed through CLIP embeddings at 224x224 resolution. The research establishes that pre-embedding alignment of modalities outperforms separate indexing strategies.
